sourceClaims: The pinned constructor sets CellularDistanceFunction_EuclideanSq and CellularReturnType_Distance.
For Euclidean distance, Distance returns F1 minus one and Distance2Sub returns F2 minus F1 minus one.
CellValue returns a normalized hash of the closest feature point, not a distance.
The cellular jitter setter warns that values above one cause artifacts.

sourceAuditFinding.finding: The remarks on SetCellularDistanceFunction and SetCellularReturnType have their default labels inverted: Distance is a return type and EuclideanSq is a distance function. Constructor state and an executable default-equivalence check were used as the contract.
sourceAuditFinding.effect: Do not copy the two remark labels into a KAOPU receipt without checking constructor state.

doesNotClaim: F2-F1 is not documented as an exact unit-slope Euclidean distance to an edge.
The source does not assign physical soil, grain, brick, tile or rock meaning to cells.
The CPU probe shares this source and test design; CI replay is not an independent physical Observation Root.
No GPU derivative, antialiasing, Mother adoption, public-device or user visual result follows from the C++ source.
